gate_results.rationale: IT gate framing snapshot satisfies every predicate of DGF-decision-v8 evaluate_it, so no candidate finding applies. REVIEW_FACTS_IT shows catalog_status=non_standard WITH waiver_present=true (waiver_expiry_days=365), so IT-CATALOG-001 is not triggered; duplicate_capability=false; license_compliant=true; cmdb_record_present=true; run_owner_present=true; technology_eol_months=18 (>=12); capacity_headroom_pct=30 (>=15); change_record_status=approved. Authoritative corroboration: TECH_CATALOG (waiver_present true, hosting_model functions), LIFECYCLE_REGISTER (eol_months 18), CMDB_EXPORT (record_present True, run_owner Leila Rossi-12005-SO), CAPACITY_REPORT (capacity_headroom_pct 30). Upstream decisions list is empty. Phase is framing, so design/build/deployment-only predicates (CMDB, run owner, capacity, change) are not in scope regardless. Negative/rework outcomes are not required here; GO is the evidence-supported disposition and no standing-mandate authorization is needed.

Applying DGF-decision-v8 evaluate_architecture to the authoritative REVIEW_FACTS_ARCHITECTURE snapshot (design phase) yields three triggered predicates and three non-triggered ones. Triggered: (1) ARCH-PERF-001 — measured_latency_ms 700 > latency_target_ms 50, corroborated by LLD 'Measured latency ms | 701' (vs target 50); medium severity, action REMEDIATE_LATENCY, disposition GO_WITH_RESERVATIONS, risk-acceptance allowed. (2) ARCH-HA-001 — project business_criticality = 'High' while architecture_profile shows multi_az false AND multi_region false; the HLD confirms 'Single-AZ / no AZ guarantee' and 'Resilience: backup_only ... DR tested: False', and AZURE_RESOURCE_GRAPH shows every resource multiAz=false with private_endpoints=false. High severity, action REDESIGN_FOR_HIGH_AVAILABILITY, disposition REWORK, risk acceptance NOT allowed. (3) ARCH-REV-001 — reversibility_status = 'missing' (LLD: 'Reversibility | missing (declared)'); medium severity, action COMPLETE_EXIT_ARCHITECTURE, GO_WITH_RESERVATIONS, risk-acceptance allowed. Not triggered: ARCH-IP-001 (ip_overlap false; IP_PLAN shows overlap_detected False for all three CIDRs 10.166.80.0/24, 10.166.81.0/24, 10.166.82.0/24 — no conflict with the authoritative IPAM record); ARCH-API-001 (api_gateway_required = false, so the absent gateway is not a gap — the LLD's contradictory 'API gateway present | True' is non-authoritative and irrelevant here, and OPENAPI exposes only an internal /health and OAuth-secured /v1/items); ARCH-DATA-001 (data_owner_present = true; DATA_MODEL names data_owner 'Sofia Ivanov-12005-BO' and lineage_complete true). Gate rollup is the highest-severity triggered disposition: REWORK (from ARCH-HA-001), which outranks the two GO_WITH_RESERVATIONS findings; REWORK is not in the policy's authorization_required_for list, so no standing-mandate authorization is required (the mandate covers only risk-acceptable findings, and the blocking ARCH-HA-001 finding explicitly does not permit risk acceptance). No upstream specialist decisions exist for this gate beyond the framing-phase IT gate (GO, no findings), which is not relevant to architecture predicates.

Applying DGF-decision-v8 evaluate_security to the authoritative REVIEW_FACTS_SECURITY snapshot (design phase) yields two triggered predicates. (1) SEC-WAF-001 (critical): the workload is internet-facing — \"internet_exposed\": true — while \"waf_present\": false and \"waf_mode\": \"None\"; the authoritative WAF_POLICY corroborates this (\"present\": false, \"mode\": \"None\"), and the HLD/ingress path (Azure Front Door edge-622c2-22005-01) terminates public traffic with no WAF in front, while NSG_RULES shows an Internet-sourced inbound Allow on 443. Action IMPLEMENT_WAF, owner Security Architect, disposition NO_GO, risk acceptance NOT allowed. (2) SEC-NET-001 (critical): the project data_classification is \"Restricted\" (with personal_data true and payment_data true) yet \"private_endpoints\": false; AZURE_RESOURCE_GRAPH confirms \"private_endpoints\": false with every sensitive service (Azure SQL Database, Azure Storage Account, Azure Cache for Redis, Data Factory) still publicNetworkAccess true. Action ENABLE_PRIVATE_ENDPOINTS, owner Cloud Platform, disposition NO_GO, risk acceptance NOT allowed. Non-triggered predicates verified: SEC-WAF-002 (requires waf_present true — it is false); SEC-IAM-001 (\"mfa\": \"mandatory\"); SEC-IAM-002 (\"shared_service_principal\": false — the stale IAM_EXPORT svc-shared entry is not authoritative over the snapshot); SEC-LOG-001 (\"logs_to_siem\": true, SENTINEL_STATUS shows sentinel true with connectors Azure Activity/Entra ID/Application); SEC-VULN-001 (\"critical_vulns_open\": 0 — VULN_SCAN shows only 7 High findings, no Critical); SEC-PENTEST-001 (phase is design, not build_acceptance, so the \"pentest_status\": \"missing\" field is not yet applicable at this gate); SEC-KEY-001 (\"key_rotation_days\": 90, not None or 365). Gate rollup is the highest-severity triggered disposition: NO_GO from both critical findings, which outranks all others. NO_GO is in the policy's authorization_required_for list, so standing-mandate authorization is required; the active mandate MANDATE-7bf8888c-...-INTEGRATE-03-SECURITY-1 covers 'all and only risk-acceptable findings', and both triggered findings have risk_acceptance_allowed=false, so the mandate cannot authorize acceptance of them — no conditional approval is available and the gate must return to design. Proposed actions are remediations, not completed remediation, and the snapshot reflects the submitted state only.

Applying DGF-decision-v8 evaluate_legal to the authoritative REVIEW_FACTS_LEGAL snapshot (design phase) yields three triggered predicates. (1) LEGAL-DPA-001 (critical): project personal_data = true while dpa_status = "missing"; the DPA document corroborates ("Status | missing") and the MSA clause 4 states "DPA status: missing". Action EXECUTE_DPA, owner Legal / Privacy, disposition REWORK, risk acceptance NOT allowed. (2) LEGAL-AUDIT-001 (high): audit_right = "reports_only", which is in the insufficient set ('reports_only','none'); MSA clause 7 confirms "Customer audit rights: reports_only", and the authoritative CONTRACT_PLAYBOOK requires audit_right "full or limited". Action REDLINE_AUDIT_RIGHT, owner Legal, disposition REWORK, risk acceptance allowed. (3) LEGAL-INS-001 (high): insurance_valid = false; MSA clause 10 confirms "Certificate valid: False". Action OBTAIN_VALID_INSURANCE, owner Supplier, disposition SUSPENSION, risk acceptance NOT allowed. Non-triggered predicates verified: LEGAL-LIAB-001 (liability_cap_multiplier = 5, not 0.5, and security_carveout = true); LEGAL-EXIT-001 (exit_assistance_days = 180, not 0); LEGAL-IP-001 (ip_ownership = "vendor", not "ambiguous"); LEGAL-SIGN-001 (signing_authority_valid = true); LEGAL-LOG-001 (log_export_clause = "limited", not "missing"). Gate rollup is the highest-severity triggered disposition: SUSPENSION (from LEGAL-INS-001) outranks REWORK. SUSPENSION is in the policy's authorization_required_for list, so standing-mandate authorization is required; however the active mandate MANDATE-...-INTEGRATE-04-LEGAL-1 covers 'all and only risk-acceptable findings', and the blocking LEGAL-INS-001 (and LEGAL-DPA-001) have risk_acceptance_allowed=false, so the mandate cannot authorize acceptance of them and no conditional approval is available. Proposed actions are remediations, not completed remediation; the snapshot reflects the submitted state only.

gate_results.rationale: Applying DGF-decision-v8 evaluate_compliance to the authoritative REVIEW_FACTS_COMPLIANCE snapshot (design phase) yields three triggered predicates. (1) COMP-DPIA-001 (high): dpia_required = true while dpia_status = \"missing\"; the DPIA document corroborates (\"Required | True\", \"Status | missing\"). Action COMPLETE_DPIA, owner DPO, disposition REWORK, risk acceptance NOT allowed. (2) COMP-RESID-001 (critical): required_residency = \"EU\" but residency_compliant = false; the authoritative DATA_INVENTORY confirms actual_region \"West US 2\" against required_residency \"EU\" for Restricted personal data. Action RELOCATE_DATA_OR_OBTAIN_VALID_BASIS, owner DPO / Architecture, disposition NO_GO, risk acceptance NOT allowed. (3) COMP-AUDIT-001 (high): audit_trail = \"missing\". Action IMPLEMENT_AUDIT_TRAIL, owner Product Team, disposition REWORK, risk acceptance NOT allowed. Non-triggered predicates verified: COMP-MAP-001 (regulatory_mapping = \"complete\"; REG_MAPPING shows mapping_status complete for PCI-DSS); COMP-A11Y-001 (accessibility_status = \"not_assessed\", not \"major_findings\"); COMP-EXPORT-001/002 (export_control = \"clear\", neither restricted nor pending). Gate rollup is the highest-severity triggered disposition: NO_GO (from the critical COMP-RESID-001), which outranks REWORK. NO_GO is in the policy's authorization_required_for list, so standing-mandate authorization is required; however the active mandate MANDATE-7bf8888c-...-INTEGRATE-05-COMPLIANCE-1 covers 'all and only risk-acceptable findings', and the blocking COMP-RESID-001 (and COMP-DPIA-001, COMP-AUDIT-001) have risk_acceptance_allowed=false, so the mandate cannot authorize acceptance of them and no conditional approval is available. Proposed actions are remediations, not completed remediation; the snapshot reflects the submitted state only.

Applying DGF-decision-v8 evaluate_general to the authoritative REVIEW_FACTS_GENERAL snapshot (governance phase) yields three triggered predicates. (1) GEN-STRAT-001 (high): strategic_alignment = "weak"; PORTFOLIO_SNAPSHOT corroborates strategic_alignment "weak" for DGF-INT-012005. Action OBTAIN_STRATEGIC_ARBITRATION, owner Sponsor, disposition SUSPENSION. (2) GEN-BUDGET-001 (high): budget_requested_eur 3000000 > budget_approved_eur 2550000; the authoritative BUDGET_APPROVAL confirms requested_eur 3000000 vs approved_eur 2550000 with status PARTIAL. Action OBTAIN_BUDGET_APPROVAL, owner CFO / Sponsor, disposition SUSPENSION. (3) GEN-UPSTREAM-NOGO (critical): two upstream gates returned NO_GO — INTEGRATE-03-SECURITY-1 (security) and INTEGRATE-05-COMPLIANCE-1 (compliance). Action RESOLVE_UPSTREAM_NO_GO, owner Project Manager, disposition NO_GO. Non-triggered predicates verified: GEN-BC-001 (roi 0.342 >= 0.05 threshold); GEN-BENEFITS-001 (phase is governance, not deployment_closure, so change_plan_status "draft" is not in scope). Gate rollup is the highest-severity triggered disposition: NO_GO (from the critical GEN-UPSTREAM-NOGO), which outranks the two SUSPENSION findings. NO_GO is in the policy's authorization_required_for list, so standing-mandate authorization is required; the active mandate MANDATE-...-INTEGRATE-06-GENERAL-1 covers 'all and only risk-acceptable findings', and the blocking GEN-UPSTREAM-NOGO has risk_acceptance_allowed=false, so the mandate cannot authorize acceptance of it and no conditional approval is available. Proposed actions are remediations, not completed remediation; the snapshot reflects the submitted state only.
